cohort: Primiparous women who had given birth to only one child by vaginal delivery or cesarean section between 2012 and 2016.
finding: Overall, 50% of the women developed one or more pelvic floor dysfunctions (including urinary incontinence, pelvic organ prolapse, and anal incontinence) within 10 years of their first birth, with a third perceiving symptoms as a dysfunction and half reporting mild or moderate symptoms.
